units.source_text: 哎呀呀，原以为总算爬上来了，谁知还在半路上……

en.t: Good grief, he had thought he had finally climbed up, only to find he was still halfway there...

units.source_text: 那么，目标的亮光哪里去了？

en.t: Then where had the light he was aiming for gone?

units.source_text: ……他怀着半信半疑的心情，又试着继续往前走了一段……

en.t: ...Half believing and half doubting, he tried walking on a little farther...

units.source_text: 确实，这里像是沙丘的棱线的顶上了……

en.t: It did seem that he was on top of the ridge line of the dunes...

units.source_text: 可是，看不见亮光，究竟是怎么回事呢？

en.t: But if he could not see the light, what on earth was going on?

units.source_text: 不祥的预感，让他的双脚打起抖来。

en.t: An ominous premonition made his legs begin to tremble.

units.source_text: 想来想去，刚才的偷懒，看来是失败的原因。

en.t: The more he thought about it, the more it seemed that his earlier laziness had caused the failure.

units.source_text: 一个陡坡，连方向也不辨，哧溜一下就滑了下去。

en.t: On a steep slope, without even checking the direction, he had slipped straight down.

units.source_text: 那峡谷可是比想象的要长得多。

en.t: That ravine was much longer than he had imagined.
It was not only deep, but also very wide.

units.source_text: 况且，几层曲折，在峡谷底部，错综复杂地交错着，这才使判断出了毛病吧。

en.t: Besides, several twisting layers crossed each other in a tangled way at the bottom of the ravine, and that must have thrown off his judgment.

units.source_text: 即使如此，他还是搞不懂为什么看不见亮光了……

en.t: Even so, he still could not understand why the light had disappeared from sight...

units.source_text: 行动半径最多只有一公里以内的误差……

en.t: The margin of error in his range of movement should have been at most within one kilometer...

units.source_text: 即使迷了路，也没什么了不起的……

en.t: Even if he had lost his way, it should not have been a serious matter...

units.source_text: 他心里老是想着靠左边走，这也许是出于对村落的警戒心，他觉得自己很可能是想接近灯光，才毅然决定选择右边那条道走的……

en.t: He had kept thinking he should stay to the left, perhaps out of wariness toward the village, and he felt that he had probably chosen the path on the right so decisively because he wanted to get closer to the light...

units.source_text: 不久，薄雾会消散，星星也会出来了……

en.t: Before long, the thin mist would clear, and the stars would come out too...

units.source_text: 无论如何得瞭望一下，他不管方向，往稍微高一点的地方攀登而去，从结果来看是最快的方法了吧……

en.t: He had to get a view somehow, so regardless of direction he climbed toward a slightly higher place, which in the end was probably the quickest way...
